title: Chat question carousel
description: The chat question carousel ("ask user a question" widget): an agent's question with a header (optional carousel message, title, skip and collapse buttons), a scrollable answer area (optional detailed message, numbered single- or multi-select options or a text input, plus a numbered "Enter custom answer" row) and a footer with the submit hint and Submit button. Captured from VS Code's own component fixtures (chatQuestionCarousel.fixture.ts) with the Dark 2026 theme. The fixture's Light variant uses Light Modern, and its rules are identical, so Light 2026 colors come from this system's tokens. The answer area's height is set from JS like the product (port of layoutInputScrollable). Known verification drift, limited to the invisible DomScrollableElement scrollbars: their sliders get 4px corners from the workbench's .modern-ui class (the fixture page lacks it; the real Agents window has it), and the fixture's vertical bar height (16px taller) is stale from before the answer area is constrained. Everything visible matches with 0 diffs.
usage: Use when an agent asks the user a question in chat (askQuestions tool / MCP elicitation). Put it inside <vsc-chat-view>. Give the question with question= (or slot="question" for bold/links), optional message= above it and slot="detail" for longer context; add <vsc-chat-question-option label description selected> children for choices (multi for checkboxes). Listen for the "submit" event (detail.answer) and "skip". Don't use it for tool or terminal approvals; those are confirmation widgets.

attributes.name: question
attributes.description: The question shown in the header title (plain text; use slot="question" for rich text)

attributes.name: message
attributes.description: Carousel-level message shown above the title (plain text; use slot="message" for rich text)

attributes.name: multi
attributes.description: Multi-select: options render as checkboxes and clicking toggles instead of submitting

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Appends " *" to the title, like a required question

attributes.name: no-freeform
attributes.description: Hide the numbered "Enter custom answer" row (allowFreeformInput: false)

attributes.name: collapsed
attributes.description: Collapsed: only the header is visible (toggled by the chevron)

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder of the text input when there are no options

attributes.name: submit-hint
attributes.description: Defaults to "⌘⏎ to submit" on macOS, "Ctrl+Enter to submit" elsewhere

slots.description: <vsc-chat-question-option> children (the answers). Without options the carousel shows a text input.

slots.name: question
slots.description: Rich question title (inline HTML: strong, a, code). Overrides the question attribute's rendering.

slots.name: message
slots.description: Rich carousel-level message above the title.

slots.name: detail
slots.description: Detailed message rendered at the top of the answer area (block HTML: h3, p, ul).

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Only the header is visible; chevron points up
states.trigger: collapsed attribute or the chevron button

states.name: selected option
states.description: Option row highlighted with a check (single) or checked checkbox (multi)
states.trigger: selected on an option, click, ↑/↓ or number keys

states.name: submitted
states.description: Clicking an option (single-select), Enter/Space in the list, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter or Submit fire a submit event

sources.note: header row: carousel message, title, actions
